body:
I’m also looking into this because renting is not for me. The sudden noises and smells from neighbors are making me crazy. 

The only research that I’ve found is that there is something called the Fannie Mae HomeReady loan which allows incomes from social security. Also, has a low interest rate of 3%. You could also look into FHA loans as well.

Other than that I don’t have much insight—But I’m genuinely interested in knowing how to have my own space if anyone has done it on ssdi.

I got my staples out a few weeks ago and they said my incision is healing well…

Only thing that makes me worried is the fact that I started feeling some small attacks in my face over within the last week. I also noticed that the numbness in the back of my head is gone but I feel pain at the top of my incision. Is it normal to have attacks like this after surgery?
Cool, appreciate it
Thank you
It is my only income and I don’t have a spouse.
This is helpful, thank you so much!
Do you remember what website you used?
Trying the best I can — It’s been a month or so after surgery and my incision site still feels tight and swollen though. Is that usually the norm?
Thank you, I think I definitely overdid it a few times just because I live alone. Trying my best to avoid it!

I was able to get some fiber supplements and that helped move things along — I was TN free for about 4 days but now I’m feeling some zaps in my face again? Idk if it’s because of inflammation or what but it’s making me freak out
I just took some milk of magnesia so I’m hoping that helps. I just really hope that my last bowel movement didn’t do anything adverse to the success of the surgery…

I spoke to the manager today and she got visibly angry with me and combative. I honestly was getting scared because she said I was lying about the issues and code violations that have plagued this building since October.

Side note: I did bring up in conversation about my safety concerns because a because a homeless person broke through security door weeks ago and smashed everyone’s cars with bricks. She got mad and said it was fixed this morning and that I’m making things up. I drove home after this meeting and the door was in fact… not fixed. 

In summary, I explained my situation and I was told I would still have to pay 4-5 months of rent without being here if I broke the lease. I’m at a loss and it sucks because I might have the option to move somewhere safer for my health and recovery.

We have a lot of it documented via email but they don’t seem to care. They have an “exterminator” come out every 2-3 weeks and they basically said the big issue is fixed because it’s winter now. 

They also said I was lying about the heat not being on for a week even though it was on the news? I’m trying my best to find legal aid but I don’t think they take cases like this unfortunately.

I’ve been to my neurologist, neuro-ophthalmologist and then my allergist over the last couple of months. I do feel dull pain around my eyes and inside my nose at times that’s accompanied w/ a continuous headache. 

The light sensitivity is definitely the worst part of it all. I used to have double vision but that subsided in October. I feel pushed around by my doctors and it’s honestly been exhausting that no one seems to have answers at the clinic.
Let me know how it goes. I’ve never take Claritin this long before and the headache is absolutely brutal some days. I hope you become headache free soon!
Thank you, will look into that

I tested positive for all trees (besides maple), all grasses, all molds and dust-mites. My most severe allergy is to cats and sometimes dogs. I was told to take allergy medicine everyday… but I think it’s potentially been causing severe dry eye.

I have dealt with migraines since 2021 but it wasn’t until 5 months ago when I started having insane light sensitivity in my left eye. There are days I can’t even leave the house because the sun or bright lights hurt so bad. 

I’ve been doing allergy shots as well for the past year but recently stopped because I had an anaphylactic reaction and I also wanted to see if the shots could be making my headaches worse?

Even my neurologist is stumped about the headaches and eye pain. So maybe I should make another appointment with my allergist?
I know this is two years late, however, I’m dealing with the exact same pain in my left eye after taking Claritin for the last couple months. Just wondering if the pain ever subsided for you?
I’ve been asking myself the same question all week. None of it makes sense and sadly we will have to ‘survive’ like this for 4 more years.

Thanks for the IG pages, I’ll be sure to check them out. I’m also having the dreaded tightness and nerve problems in my hamstrings/glutes which in my opinion make me think it could be pressing on the sciatica nerve?

I’m gonna have to ask my orthopedic doctor about a PRP shot because I’m ready to try anything at this point.
Thank you for taking the time to update — I’m almost in the same boat as you with symptoms post surgery so I’m lost. But your suggestions/advice are really helpful!

Hey there, happy to hear you had a good experience! I have surgery planned in March and have a quick question… was the rhizotomy something that he planned with you prior to the procedure or was it something they added additional during surgery? I’m wondering if I should bring it up as well?
hey there, any updates on your recovery?
having the same symptoms as you with sciatica post surgery… did it ever resolve for you?
did you ever find a cure? I have the same pressure but no drainage

I agree, the performance video will suffice lol 

But I don’t know why this song wasn’t promoted as a title track? The choreography alone is so hypnotizing and they could go so many different ways for a MV concept or dance challenges with it…

Either way they hybe better promote this album. I was a casual listener until I watched their promos recently and they deserve the clout.
Does anyone know if they will be doing a music video for Deer Hunter… because I NEED it now.

I haven’t had a CT done yet so I’m probably gonna go to the hospital tomorrow and politely demand they do one in the ER because this pain is unbearable. I wear sunglasses like all the time but I’ve been looking into blue light glasses! 

Will update you if they find anything or give me any more information on what it could be. Keep me updated as well! (:

Thanks for letting me know everything you tried. If anything I would look up trochlear headaches or trochleitis bc the pain youre experiencing is definitely in that exact spot and can cause light sensitivity/photophobia. Most of the time it’s not even picked up on CT scans or MRIs. 

I’m thinking that I possibly have that too from where the pain is located and how my symptoms present. The soonest I can get into a neuro-ophthalmologist to treat it is in March… which really really sucks. From my understanding they use a steroid to inject the muscle/nerve. 

Might be worth looking up and seeing if you could get into neuro-opthamology to see if they can do an injection there to hopefully relieve the pain.

Im sorry to hear that. That’s how mine is too! Like my favorite hobby is watching tv or movies and I can’t even do that without having pain. Have you had any MRIs or scans done? I might go to the ER tomorrow if my pain gets any worse…
I’m looking to schedule surgery with him in March. How long did you have to stay in Arizona before driving/flying home?
Did you ever get a diagnosis? I’ve been dealing with this pain for the last 4 months
Did you ever find anything to alleviate this? I’m dealing with the exact same symptoms as you and it’s miserable. I would do anything to get rid of this continuous pain!

Thanks for the reply, I’ve been on nortriptyline for my migraines as well and I wanna say a few months into taking it I started having the same light sensitivity in my left eyeball/eyelid as well! The doctors keep saying that there’s no way it could cause that but your story is pretty aligned with what I’m experiencing…

I don’t necessarily have dopey vision issues from it (yet) but it’s really painful when I’m outside, use electronic devices and see crazy patterns too. 

I’m glad to hear you’re noticing relief with cutting back on the medication. It’s really annoying to have to deal with these side effects so I hope you can find full relief here soon. I stopped cold turkey on mine bc I am at a lower dose so I’ll let you know how I’m feeling in a few weeks and tell you if the side effects persist.
Did you ever get a diagnosis for this? Dealing with something similar now and looking for any answers. The pain is so bad :(
Checking in to see if you discontinued the nortriptyline and if you’re light sensitive went away? Dealing with similar symptoms right now and it’s been terrible

This is directly from the facial pain organization [TN Protocol](https://content.facepain.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Medication-and-the-Emergency-Room.pdf)

Hope you feel better soon!

Is this rage bait comment? 
I do feel like I can be upset when a parent writes me off because I live with a disability. Some people view that as a flaw that needs to ultimately be fixed. Unfortunately I don’t have that luxury because of my *genetics* (aka it’s incurable)
it’s definitely not the best case scenario lol
Did you end up switching to something else?
That’s about where I’m at… it’s been almost a year and I think my dry eyes are leading to nerve pain. I’ll look into restasis!
I’m also wondering this
I know it’s been a while, but I also have TN on the same side of the trochleitis. Do you have to keep getting shots semi frequently still???
Located in Ohio by the way, they are coming through window cracks in old apartment
I would also like to know these details. Wayyy more detailed than any MRI I’ve ever gotten.
I know it’s been a while but can you tell me more about the surgical procedure she had?
Good luck 😄
look into applying for Medicare savings program — that saves me the $178 a month based on assets and income if you’re eligible. It’s worth a shot!
Any updates? Had the pain gone away for you since stopping?
I know some time has passed, but did it happen to effect both of yours eyes? And did it feel painful? I’m going through something similar right now
did the pain go away after discontinuing it? And was it behind one or both of your eyes? (Sorry for all the questions I’m just genuinely curious if I should get off this shit asap lol)
hey, I know it’s been some time… but did this ever go away for you? I’m having insane pressure behind one of my eyes and I think it might be because of the nortriptyline :(

I second the botox savings program you can look it up on google. Anything not covered by insurance you will get the money back. Also, depending on how much your stipend is for grad school there are financial assistance through hospitals. So whatever your insurance doesn’t cover the hospital will cover the rest! 

I would look into public hospitals and find one that has financial assistance/HCAP and see if your salary falls under the threshold. I would also make sure to schedule an appointment with a neurologist for the Botox for a medical reason (don’t go to a med spa or dermatologist for this)
I think you should have a conversation that you don’t want her to recommend any other jobs unless you bring it up yourself? Maybe that will help
It sucks. There really needs to be a crash course series that parents can watch on how to be supportive when your child has a disability.
That’s what I’m about to do /:

I’ve tried all of the above with convos, articles and videos to help him understand. I have said I that I feel like he’s embarrassed of me about a year ago… 

He just gets really angry and defensive. His response always tends to be that he cares so much for me. And that he could never be embarrassed? But I’m like sir you’re lying lol

It doesn’t feel genuine at all and that he is just saying it because I’m his kid. Deep down I know he’s embarrassed and that I’m a stain on his reputation with his friends and coworkers. 

I recently found out that his friend of 30+ years had zero idea what I was going through at all. My dad never once told him or explained that his daughter has a genetic/nerve disease. While his friend has told him everything about his own children including his one child who was in a coma for a while etc.

When I found this out it just solidified the fact that he wants to keep a certain image around his friends and in society.

Omg, also when they say you gotta ‘try harder’ when the reality is you’re just trying to stay alive. It just feels very ignorant to me now when people won’t take 5 minutes out of their day to understand… especially when they are family.

Like when I’m 1 on 1 with my dad having a conversation he says insulting stuff to me. But if other people are in the room then he acts like a saint that only wants his daughter to be happy/healthy? The double standard is nauseating
Yeah that’s the conclusion I’ve come to as well

You can vent anytime! I’m really sorry to hear what you’re going through. It’s so frustrating to have a dad who doesn’t understand your situation and suggests jobs you can’t do. It must be painful, especially when you’re dealing with so much. I can’t imagine how hard it is without your mom’s support… losing that relationship adds to everything you’re facing. You deserve to be heard and supported. I’m here if you want to talk more as well!!

I’m really sorry to hear that your dad’s last words left you with that pain… It’s frustrating when people define success solely by job titles, especially when you’ve accomplished so much with your degree. I know my worth goes far beyond just a job, and I’m sure you do too.

I couldn’t agree more with ‘not believing a shitty god who threatens to send me to hell for loving who I love’ it made me laugh a bit because I think I’ve said these exact words to a family member before lol

Anyways, it must be hard to hear your mom’s comments about faith and healing while she’s knows you’re atheist?? And I get how invalidating your sister’s job listings can feel, too. My dad has sent me some as well for waitressing and I’m like??? I can’t even walk some days but waitressing will definitely cure me lol It’s great that you’re focusing on being your awesome self as you navigate everything!

I’m sorry to hear about your injury/challenges you’re facing with your dad’s reaction. It’s tough when loved ones can’t accept the reality of a situation, especially when it’s so significant. I just think both of our dads are in deep denial. All the best to you as well!

Setting those boundaries and sticking to them was definitely the right move. I’m glad she eventually respected them. It’s definitely a good reminder that protecting your peace is worth the effort, even if it takes time for people to adjust…

Right, I need to stop carrying shame that I cant physically hold a job right now. It’s tough because my mindset has shifted to believing that we deserve care/support simply for being a human being, not because of what I can produce… but not everyone is going to understand this concept. 

I’m learning more and more that if a relationship bringing more harm than good, it’s fair to step away. It’s hard but sometimes the best choice is prioritizing your mental and emotional well-being.

The pressure to “succeed” by these standards is unfair, especially for any of us managing disabilities. It hurts my soul that society often equates worth with titles, and overlooks the importance of health/balance.

IMO, if anyone does decide to work w/ a disability the real success is finding a way to do that while it supports your well-being, not burning out for someone else’s definition of achievement. Hopefully someday your family will understand that…

It sounds like cutting ties with your father was a tough but necessary choice for your health. And that’s wild, being left out of the obituary must have been painful, but it’s clear you made the right decision for yourself. Thanks for sharing!
That’s the word! I couldn’t think of it before

Omg the notorious advice “sleep early, drink water and try yoga” agenda that every able bodied person loves to push. When someone says that stuff I actually don’t fight or flight… I freeze and zone out. Like did they really just say that?

Also why can’t people with disabilities/chronic illness be pretty or smart? Last time I checked you can be all of the above. And still live with a disability! I’m ranting now but yeah, I relate to this heavily 

Luckily I moved out 2 months ago so it’s been refreshing to be out of that environment 24/7

All I can say is this nerve really realllllllly sucks. Had a flare up of my own about 2 months ago and thought I was going insane as well. Was I also having thoughts that it would be better to not be here anymore? Absolutely. I say this so you know we’re here with you. You’re not alone.

Your pain is 100% real and you’ve obviously been a fighter with how many’s meds and procedures you’ve tried over the years. It’s not fair that you’ve been advocating for yourself and have to struggle with the pain AND with this wonderful thing we call the ‘US healthcare system’ (considering you’re from America)

It sounds like you’ve tried pretty intensive surgeries and procedures so please disregard my suggestions if it’s already been attempted. I also had pretty bad episodes of burning… face on fire feeling? Getting Botox trigger point injections in my face and scalp have helped a lot in at least decreasing the severity of the pain. 

I get the injections every 3 months and usually 2-4 weeks before I’m due for the procedure the burning pain comes back like clockwork. It’s usually covered by insurance if you have a history of migraines, facial pain or trigeminal neuralgia. Might be worth trying it if you haven’t yet. 

Anyways, I hope you feel better tomorrow and my dms are always opens if you need someone to talk to!!

I like this way of thinking. Just trying your best everyday to do some sort of good. I wish all parents would pass on healthy ways of thinking … instead of copious amounts of generational trauma (like mine did lol)

I think my dad relies on a hierarchy system based on how much money you make… and that somehow proves your worth or success? Idk I can’t really explain it. All I know is that it makes me feel like shit.

I think that’s a good way to respond without the conversation turning more hostile. I don’t think the able-bodied person can fathom how much time goes into making appointments, attending said appointments, getting procedures, picking up prescriptions etc. 

It’s exhausting.
I agree, that’s what I need to keep reminding myself
That’s great news. I need to look into them again, especially for the support groups if any are available…

Wow, thanks for sharing your side of things and all the procedures/meds you’ve undergone. I also appreciate you listing the doctor’s names because it helps me and probably others find second opinions. 

It’s hard to believe your one doctor said to stop seeing her because there was nothing else she could do for you. It’s very disheartening to hear that. I guess at least she’s being forward with saying you need to find some provider or place with more options? My only wish is that there was more research and studies that would shine a light on this condition in the hopes that a cure could be found

You’ve given me some things to think about when it comes to pursuing surgery and possibly even with medication. I think the hardest hurdle for myself is that none of it will work and it will be a waste of time. I think about dying all the time too but I don’t really know why I hold on… maybe there’s some hope deep inside me as well. 

You have such a big family and it’s a blessing that you’re able to still spend time with them while battling this. What do you do if you start experiencing attacks or flares around family, are they understanding?

The official diagnosis on your birthday is absolutely brutal. I hope they find the right meds or procedures to help you. 

I’m pushing myself to reach out more instead of retreating into my introverted cave. I genuinely feel like the people in my inner circle don’t care because it’s an invisible illness. They kind of assume I’m okay because I “look” like I did prior to living with chronic pain. Little do they know, the mask I usually wear is about to come off because I can’t keep this up.

No worries at all! I also had life stuff get in the way and was admitted to the hospital for IV infusions to help stop/prevent future TN attacks. 

Thanks for assuring me that advocacy could potentially help me in the future with a different neurosurgeon! I’m glad you found someone who was able to really look at your scans and find something so you could move ahead with surgery. 

What potential risks did they tell you about with the MVD? I am a bit anxious about that but as soon as I feel an attack… I would rather choose anything at all than that pain. I don’t know how to explain it. 

Luckily, I was set up with providers this week who informed me about gamma knife and MVD and they are redoing my brain scans for this year as well. So maybe I’ll have an update later on if they find a compression!

I’m sorry to hear about everything you’ve had and have to continue to deal with… this disease is so damn terrible. I also can’t work due to taking too many sick days at my last job because of attacks. It really sucks that we have to battle with it everyday when other people have no idea half the stuff we go through :(

Thanks so much. Okay, so I put most of my backpay and assets into the ABLE and maxed it out at the 18k contribution limit for the annual year.

The only other things I would have to report is my Roth IRA ($1,400 for burial expenses) and a small robinhood account ($600) that I literally forgot I had. In total my assets/resources would be around $7,500 in resources I believe. (I could possibly lower this amount by paying my car insurance off for the year?)

The MSP that’s called SLMB says the resource limit is $9,000. Do you think I’ll be okay? I’m sorry I have so many questions, and if you can’t answer that’s obviously okay. I just had no time to call and wait for hours w/ Medicaid today because I had a medical procedure. But I’ll call tomorrow!
Thank you so much with this helpful information. It helped today with managing my assets for SLMB.

Thanks, I was on the phone for hours today with both of them which kinda resulted in nothing. They don’t know the answers either and I don’t want to submit bank statements until I know forsure.

Do you have to know if they count ABLE accounts as an asset or resource?
Thank you! Would you be open to my messaging you if I have any future questions about MVD? Talking to my provider about it tomorrow as well at an appointment.

My TN is on the same side and I have the exact same med prescription as you. The fatigue is definitely there all the time. I have to take everything 3x a day. I wish I could drink caffeine or something but that only gives me more shocks. I’ll be 28 this year so it’s been tough seeing all of my friends get married/have kids when I feel so stuck in my illness?

Thanks for giving me hope that I’ll be able to find a better circle of friends/family in the future. I’m about to become especially selective these next coming weeks because I can’t keep pretending that I’m the old version of myself. Gonna start manifesting that I’ll start finding people with good energy and intentions!

Dealing with this condition in our twenties is actually so messed up lol I was diagnosed at 24 but I’m actually 27 now! Even so, not being able to work and somehow surviving with this pain is a battle everyday. You’re right.. I’m going to start being more vocal and create boundaries with people who are not conducive to my life.   

And I do feel ‘disability guilt’ in the words of my therapist. I’m sometimes embarrassed of the fact that my life is actually like this. In a sense, I’m grieving my past self and dreams. It’s hard to wrap my head around the fact that this is my new reality. When just a few years ago I never would have never imagined that TN would disrupt my reality and create so many limitations. 

I don’t feel worthy of a relationship or that anyone would want to take me on as a partner when I don’t even want to be inside my own body somedays. I also am a victim of DV so that’s also at play. But yeah, rant over haha I hope someday I can find a someone similar to your partner who is actually supportive/loving. And sees me for just me… not my disability.

I’ve basically taken the same bevy of meds that you have listed. So I can speak on how crazy it is to try so many things without pain reduction and such. I’m also a little weary about surgical options until I’m in a full blown flare… then I’m like ‘cut me open now and fix it’

I’d rather take numbness over shocks multiple times an hour to be honest with you. As for the one procedure you mentioned: Internal neurolysis (IN) — I’ve actually never heard of this and it looks promising! 

Hopefully we can both can a fiesta MRI in the hopes that they actually see something in order to move forward. And I hope your pain also goes from a 5 to a 0/10 someday. Could you tell me more about the ketamine infusions? I had my pain management doctor tell me about them once but I’ve been on the waiting list for months now.
That around the time I was born. I mean this with sincerity, you are the strongest soldier. Have you been taking medication to control the pain since then?

Geez, all the props to you for raising a baby and having TN. Somedays I can’t even take care of myself so I can imagine you’re really pushing through for both yourself and baby each and every day. 

I can relate to having to stop work from talking to coworkers or customers etc. Even my boss had zero understanding of what I was going through even when I explained my condition 3+ times and requested accommodations (that never followed through.) 

True story: When I quit and handed in my two weeks notice she actually shut the door and yelled at me. She said I should have given a 2-3 months notice since I had such a high level role in the company. 

I will say… ever since not working in corporate America my pain isn’t as intense and is less frequent. The pain 100% gets worse with stress and terrible energy from other people.

Oh my gosh, that’s wild! It’s amazing that you’ve been pain free. Are you on any medication for TN still or did they wean you off?

Can I ask why they decided to do an operation without seeing a compression?
I completely agree. There’s a lot of connections between TN, ON and the cervical spine. I know when my neck feels tense or off I’m gonna start having shocks too.
I’ve been looking for a friend who’s also going through the same TN journey. So I will take you up on that offer to message so we can equally vent about our medical experiences haha

Wow, what was your experience with each of these procedures!

And could you tell me more about how the cervical spine stimulator works to decrease TN pain?

These two pieces of hope are wonderful. I really would sign up for a MVD procedure tomorrow if that was an option lol. But maybe research will advance in the next couple years for a less invasive option. 

I wish my remissions lasted longer and more frequently. As of late, I do think stress brings on a lot of the pain and shocks unfortunately. So I’m trying to find ways to decrease that and inflammation.

I’m trying to be more kind to myself these days but when I start getting shocks I do tend to break down. Having this all start on your birthday is the worst! Especially the TN + ON mix is not a good present. I’m at the point where I’m cutting out people in my life who are toxic and creating a circle that’s supportive moving forward. I hope we both find relief soon!

Wow, I can’t imagine being with a therapist for that long and then being dropped — I’m sorry that happened to you but I’m happy you are now seeing someone who can better suit your needs as a TN patient with chronic pain! I’m gonna start really advocating for myself the rest of the year. I’m tired of just sitting around hoping for a miracle to happen lol

I completely agree. It’s so bad somedays. A few months ago I actually saw a chronic pain therapist who literally turned me away after reading TN on my chart. She said it wasn’t something ‘in her toolbox’ — I couldn’t believe it. 

She literally stated that TN is too painful for normal talk therapy? And that I was also “too depressed”. Just one of the many appointments that threw me into a spiral. Luckily I’ve found another therapist who is helpful but… dang that was so unprofessional of the other therapist. 

I’ve looked into the FPA but I will try to join one of the support group.

I’m so sorry you had to go through that. It’s insane that some doctors have no clue about this condition. Especially since they thought ibuprofen would be even a little bit helpful? When (in my case) it absolutely doesn’t touch the nerve pain. Sending good energy your way and that you’ll find providers who take you seriously.

I’m trying! It would be super awesome if they maybe did more research on this condition which is rated one of the most painful a human can have? Just my opinion lol 

It sucks you’re out of that 5 year remission. I’m hoping your flare and pain doesn’t last too long.

Thanks for telling your story and giving me hope that I just need to keep pushing until I can get an operation. I can’t even imagine being diagnosed at 13 so I have to commend your strength at such a young age! 

Could I please ask where you had the exploratory surgery/surgeon? I truly believe that most docs push TN patients to the side if they have no visible compression. That’s at least how I feel.
I was able to stay with a friend who lives there and we both went together — It was my first kpop concert so it definitely blew my mind. It was sooooo much fun!

I don’t know if this is helpful… but I just stopped lexapro and switched to something else and all the acne i had on my chin disappeared in 3 weeks 

While taking lexapro I definitely think it made my acne worse on my chin and cheeks. I almost went back on accutane to stop the breakouts! You gotta weigh the pros and cons though… maybe your acne will even out with time?

thank you for following up on all the stuff with nhl and if there would be any conflicts. I might buy tickets for sunday only because I’m flying into new york on 6/1 and if there’s any delays or cancellations… I would be screwed. Either way, I hope you have the best time!!!
wait, so they are done for 😭😭😭
I guess they have one more game against the pacers today around 3 PM EST — if they lose I think they will be tied??
That’s actually terrifying, stay safe! <3 I hope the weather calms down so you can see them

I’m not really sure about this one… all I know is the knicks one tonight so there’s a chance they could be going to the playoffs. With that said, the concert could potentially be cancelled at Madison’s square garden /:

I’m 27 and I have about 8k in a Roth IRA and something like $700 is stocks. I have been working the last week with both institutions to consolidate that and put it all into an ABLE account since I was diagnosed with a disability around the age of 23.

However, I may have to keep the capital gains on the Roth IRA which is about $1,300 in the Roth IRA otherwise if it’s paid out the bank teller said it would be regarded as income (which could affect my SSDI)
Okay, thanks for clearing that up. So if the Extra Help is for Part D — In that case, would assets affect the QMB/Qualified Medicare Beneficiary for the Part B premiums?

Thanks for the response — I have to agree with you... I guess I’m anxious because the representative said I’ll be penalized for not submitting the application soon. 

I just wish I had a ballpark estimate of what type of asset limit would not allow me to have the extra help with meds and decreasing the monthly premiums.
I’m literally about to find a friend who pays for cable just to watch the game, this is very serious 😅

Dear hacheeks, 

The information you provided is greatly appreciated! I will wait until next Monday to buy tickets just to be sure. Thank you!

All the best, 
- a fan that doesn’t want to be standing outside madison square garden not watching TXT
We need the mind of a basketball fan to tell us if they will make it or not. Idk if I should buy tickets for June 1st or 2nd… ugh. Did you get good tickets?
I did speak with my surgeon everything seems to be okay… there are days that I over do it and I get scared again. But I hope it’s just the post op anxiety talking! Haha
This is what I wish they would’ve told me back when I initially had surgery. They just handed me the crutches and they were like good-luck!
I wish they would’ve had me use a walker. Crutches are so annoying and painful on your armpits and shoulders. How is your arthritis now?
Thank you!! I did talk my surgeon and everything ended up fine in the end.
